content.text: With the tigers, I think it’s just ticket sales (new business, client services and group sales), suite sales and fantasy camp.
I’m going through the 2020 media guide
The females under the ‘Ticket Sales’ staff look exactly the way you’d expect they do. One of them lasted 5 months
Happy father’s day, dude. Thank you for all of the help, especially last few days
Thanks man...no problem and good luck.
I’m sure this is obvious, but nobody will know where you got these phone numbers, I assume, right? I’m sure some wouldn’t care but maybe some would. Who knows
Absolutely not, and thanks again for getting them to me. Got a hold of a couple today, we’ll see. It’s an extremely uncomfortable thing to reach out about
Yea I’m sure it is. Especially since they don’t expect to hear from you and some don’t even know who you are
And some I already know don’t want to talk to me, kinda thing
Like so and so says they probably won’t talk
Right. It’s a hard story to put together no matter how you do it
